newsitem.title: ITALY: Average family income in Italy rose 4.5 pct in '95.
newsitem.headline: Average family income in Italy rose 4.5 pct in '95.

text.p: The average net disposable monthly income of families in Italy rose 4.5 percent year-on-year to 3.533 million lire in 1995, the national statistics institute ISTAT said on Tuesday.
It said 18.4 percent of familes had a disposable monthly income of below 1.8 million lire and 18.4 percent of families an income of above 5.0 million.
In less developed southern Italy, families had an average net disposable monthly income of 2.884 million lire compared with 4.006 million in northwest Italy.
Average consumer price inflation in 1995 in Italy was 5.4 percent.
